Aarthi / team — thanks, noted. Quick summary from our side and attachments with numbers: BigCorp_DEDICATED_Sizing_v1.xlsx and OEM_quote_NVIDIA_20270501.pdf attached.

High-level options (fastest -> reliable):

- Short-term bridge: carve out reserved cloud capacity (Stratus or ACME partners) — ~2-4 weeks to reserve, operational in 4-6 weeks depending on region. Token-based billing, no hardware ownership.
- Dedicated reserved (Redwood Dedicated using OEM-procured nodes): typical OEM lead time 12-16 weeks from PO for high-demand A800-class SKUs; expediting can reduce to ~8-10 weeks with premium and confirmed allocation.
- Hybrid: reserve a partial cloud pool for initial months, backfill with OEM nodes as they arrive; this minimizes latency/regional constraints.

Key constraints to call out:
- OEM quotes below assume 32GB A800 equivalent; final pricing/lead time sensitive to confirmed PO quantity and multi-supplier windows.
- If BigCorp needs strict data isolation on day 1, cloud bridge requires VPC-only configuration and an approved security review (2-3 business days).

Next asks:
- Ben/Marissa: can you share an expedited OEM contact or alternate suppliers (ACME OEM)?
- Kimberly: please confirm whether finance needs a hard cap on expedite premiums for procurement.

Rafael
Head of Deal Ops, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

Adding commercial context — BigCorp is targeting a signed SOW before the end of May. Two quick notes:

- From a deal-structure perspective we can offer a staged commit: 3-month reserve + balance to 12 months. This lets them start with ~20 nodes in month 1 and scale to 50 by month 4.
- OEM expediting: I reached out to an alternate supplier (Acme OEM); they said if we commit a minimum 30-unit PO they can prioritize allocation and quote a 7–9 week lead time, but at ~$2.1k/unit expedite premium. See suggested language for procurement below.

Suggested message to Procurement (can be sent as-is):
- Option A (fastest): Reserve 20 nodes in Redwood Dedicated via cloud partner for immediate availability; sign staged SOW to add 30 nodes via OEM PO with expedite clause (7–9 weeks).
- Option B (single PO): Full 50-node OEM PO — expect 12–16 weeks standard, or 8–10 weeks if acme/nvidia confirm allocation (requires premium and downpayment).

I’ll loop in my ACME contact if we get a green light.

—Ben
